Staging (test builds): vault release log

Staging release 13 (test build)

Release 13 runs your vault on a newer, hardened kernel, lets its process use only the system calls it needs, and fixes long conversations that would not open.

The current release. New vaults are enrolled into it, and the app offers it to everyone on an older release.

Changes

  • Fix: opening a long conversation could fail with no answer, and trying again failed the same way. Messages now come in pages, newest first, and a reply too large to send is answered with an error instead of silence.
  • Hardening: the enclave now runs Linux 6.6.158, built by VettID from kernel.org source with a hardened configuration and reproduced on two builders, instead of the older kernel supplied with AWS's tools. Every release carries a copy of it and its source.
  • Hardening: the kernel now refuses module loading, kernel replacement, user namespaces and other features a vault does not use, and the vault does not start unless these settings hold.
  • Hardening: a vault's process may now make only the system calls it is known to need, may not start other programs, and cannot see other vaults' processes.

Security

Security fix: update recommended (affects releases 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12)

Release 13 narrows what a fault in a vault's process could reach: the enclave's kernel is current and hardened, and a vault's process can use only the parts of it the vault needs. Earlier releases ran an older kernel and refused only a short list of system calls. We know of no use of this against any vault. Your PIN and credential password were not exposed.
